pageHint: A role bundles permissions. An account can have several roles and then receives all of their permissions.
modalDescription: Name, description and permissions of the role.
lockedHint: The Admin role always has all permissions, including future ones, and cannot be changed.
exceedsOwn: This role contains permissions you do not have yourself. You therefore cannot change it.
notOwned: Contains permissions you do not have yourself.
deleteConfirm: Delete role “{name}”? This is only possible if no account still has it.

fields.name: Name
fields.nameHelpSystem: Leave empty for the default name.
fields.requireMfaHelp: Everyone with this role signs in with a second factor. Existing accounts have 3 days to set it up, new ones set it up at their first login.

userRoles.label: Roles
userRoles.help: Several roles are possible. The account receives all permissions of the selected roles.
userRoles.mfaWarning: At least one selected role contains administration rights: the account must sign in with MFA.

effective.title: Effective permissions
effective.none: No permissions. The account only sees its own data.

read.label: View meetings
read.description: View events, finalized minutes, agenda items and tasks, export PDFs.

read_drafts.label: View drafts
read_drafts.description: Also view minutes that are not finalized yet, and their files.

edit.label: Edit meetings
edit.description: Create, edit and delete events, minutes, agenda items, tasks and lists; Word import.

approve.label: Approve protocols
approve.description: Approve and close protocols. With the four-eyes principle, not one you wrote yourself.

edit.label: Design templates
edit.description: Edit building blocks, library and design of existing protocol and document templates.

manage.label: Manage templates
manage.description: Create and delete protocol templates, manage cycles, task packages, tags and historical list states.

manage.label: Manage participants
manage.description: View, create, edit and import participants including contact details, and assign them to templates.

read.label: View members
read.description: View the member list and person pages, without contact details.

export.label: Export personal data
export.description: Create data access requests for other people (all data of a person as ZIP).

manage.label: Manage finances
manage.description: Record, change and delete transactions, accounts and fines.

personal.label: Personal data of everyone
personal.description: See fines and attendance of all persons. Without this permission only your own.

manage.label: Manage files & photos
manage.description: Manage files, photo gallery and albums, public share links and album shares.

read.label: View storage
read.description: View and download files in the shared storage.

read.label: View submissions
read.description: View submitted items and their files.

manage.label: Manage submissions
manage.description: Create, review and delete submission requests and public upload links.

manage.label: Manage settings
manage.description: Organization profile, privacy, retention, verification domain, design, publishing document templates, activity log.

manage.label: Manage users & roles
manage.description: Manage logins, roles and role assignments, reset other users' MFA.

export.label: Data exports
export.description: Full export of the organization and data access requests for other persons.

complete_own.label: Complete own tasks
complete_own.description: Tick off and reopen your own tasks. Without this right, access is read-only.

manage.label: Manage fines
manage.description: Record, collect and revert fines; tariffs and task fine rules.

read.label: View photos
read.description: View and download the photo gallery and albums.

manage.label: Manage photos
manage.description: Upload, tag and delete photos; albums and partner sharing.

public.label: Share publicly
public.description: Create and revoke public links for files, albums and submission uploads.

read.label: View activity log
read.description: Who changed what and when (organisation activity log).

permissionsHelp: A role bundles permissions; an account gets all permissions of its roles. «MFA» means: whoever has it signs in with a second factor. «Module not booked»: only takes effect with that subscription module. Greyed out: you do not have it yourself, or it follows from another permission.
notOwnPermission: Locked: you do not have this permission yourself.

scopes.label: Scope
scopes.fixedHelp: Applies to all because another permission of this role includes it for all.

templatePicker.title: New role from template
templatePicker.description: The template pre-fills the form. A role of your own is saved, which you can adjust freely afterwards; it is not linked to the template.
templatePicker.omitted: {count, plural, one {You don't hold # permission yourself, it is left out.} other {You don't hold # permissions yourself, they are left out.}}

templateApplied: Template “{name}” applied. Check the permissions and save the role.
templateOmitted: Not applied because you don't hold them yourself: {permissions}

president.name: President
president.description: Chairs meetings and finalises minutes, sees cash book, members and reports.

secretary.name: Secretary
secretary.description: Writes minutes, maintains templates, members and storage.

treasurer.name: Treasurer
treasurer.description: Manages cash book and fines, sees draft minutes and the member list.

auditor.name: Auditor
auditor.description: Read only: minutes incl. drafts, cash book, members, reports and storage.

reviewer.name: Submission reviewer
reviewer.description: Reviews only the submissions they are assigned to.

member.name: Member
member.description: Like the standard Reader role: view meetings, complete own tasks.

preview.title: View as {name}
preview.description: This is how this account sees hocX with its saved roles.
preview.readOnlyHint: Preview only: no session of the account is opened and nothing is changed. The access is recorded in the activity log.
preview.noLogin: The account currently cannot sign in. Shown is what it would see after signing in.
preview.navigationEmpty: No menu items besides the start page.
preview.submissionsAll: {count, plural, =0 {All submission requests (currently none)} other {All submission requests (#)}}
preview.submissionsAssigned: {count, plural, =0 {Assigned submission requests only, currently none} other {Assigned submission requests only: #}}
